mapper.select: SELECT FROM device_command c WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM device_command c WHERE c.device_key=#{deviceKey} AND c.idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT FROM device_command c WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM device_command c WHERE c.device_key=#{deviceKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM device_command c JOIN command_outbox o ON c.id=o.command_id WHERE o.published=FALSE AND c.status IN ('PENDING','DISPATCHED') ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT 50
SELECT FROM device_command c WHERE c.status IN ('PENDING','DISPATCHED') AND c.expires_at <= #{now} LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE device_command SET status=#{command.status},result=#{result},late_result=#{late},version=#{command.version} WHERE id=#{command.id} AND version=#{expected}
UPDATE command_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error} WHERE command_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT result FROM mock_command_execution WHERE command_id=#{id} AND device_key=#{deviceKey}
